arguments.prompt:
Create a professional native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Daedolon. EXACT selected incarnation: Hexen: Beyond Heretic (1995), Daedolon Mage with Sapphire Wand.
FIXED APPEARANCE: Adult lean Daedolon Arcanum mage, deep blue hooded robe, belt and dark boots, compact crystal-blue Sapphire Wand, human hands; no cleric serpent staff or fighter axe. FIXED EQUIPMENT: Sapphire Wand. FIXED ACTION: Trait du Sapphire Wand de Daedolon. Effect damage; delivery projectile. 

Adult fictional/stylized game character. Detailed clear 16-bit pixel art, consistent three-quarter side view FACING SCREEN-RIGHT. Preserve the same body proportions, outfit, exact equipment and scale in every figure. Standing body stays full height; kneeling naturally shorter. Complete head, hands and both feet in every pose. No costume from another game or later incarnation.

STRICT LAYOUT: EXACTLY FORTY-EIGHT whole distinct figures arranged EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS (8x6). Every four adjacent figures is a real distinct FOUR-FRAME SEQUENCE. Large transparent gutters between ALL figures; complete silhouette and full weapon/staff tips always inside each cell. No overlap, no cropped extremity. Transparent background; no grid, labels, letters, numbers, scenery, ground, cast shadows, panel borders or other people.

ROW1 columns1-4 INTRO: four quiet approach/plant feet/raise hands/settle poses, the fixed source weapon held safely, never firing or striking outside an explicit action row. Columns5-8 OUTRO: four lower hands/turn shoulders/step back/settle poses; no firing.
ROW2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: four restrained nod/brief acknowledgment/shift weight/settle poses. Columns5-8 ROUND DEFEAT: four lower shoulders/catch breath/stoop/steady poses; unharmed, no firing or attack.
ROW3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Keep the actual weapon/emitter and its muzzle completely visible: brace, raise/aim to screen-right, physical release with compact recoil, lower back to guard. Tiny local muzzle flash only in the release pose, no ray crossing a cell. For staff/wand, a tiny source-coloured local tip spark only. No detached large projectile. Four separate physical stages, solo demonstration, no opponent. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four calm acknowledgment poses with different actual hand/foot postures from round victory; no firing.
ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH DEFEAT: four lower head/lean or crouch/steady/settle poses, intact unharmed character. Columns5-8 SUPER: Keep the actual weapon/emitter and its muzzle completely visible: brace, raise/aim to screen-right, physical release with compact recoil, lower back to guard. Tiny local muzzle flash only in the release pose, no ray crossing a cell. For staff/wand, a tiny source-coloured local tip spark only. No detached large projectile. Four newly drawn poses, different actual drawings from finishing, same exact source equipment/action.
ROW5 columns1-4 IDLE: four subtle breathing/weight-transfer poses with clearly different actual hand/shoulder/foot positions. Columns5-8 RUN: four genuine locomotion strides, alternating planted leg and lifted leg, the fixed source weapon held safely, never firing or striking outside an explicit action row.
ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Keep the actual weapon/emitter and its muzzle completely visible: brace, raise/aim to screen-right, physical release with compact recoil, lower back to guard. Tiny local muzzle flash only in the release pose, no ray crossing a cell. For staff/wand, a tiny source-coloured local tip spark only. No detached large projectile. Four newly drawn stages distinct from super and finishing. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four non-graphic flinch/guard/steady/recover poses, intact and unharmed.

All48 are independently drawn, no duplicate figure or same drawing shifted, no mirrored pose counted as a new drawing. Eight columns, six rows, complete consistent silhouette and generous alpha margins everywhere. Non-graphic solo acting only, no victim, injury, blood, corpse, dismemberment or death. Outside action sequences, no firing, offensive glow or unexplained aura. Support characters NEVER gain attacks or damaging effects. These are generated adaptations, no copied official sprite frames.

Sapphire Wand action: only a small BLUE local crystal-tip flash in release frame. No orange gunfire flame.

output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-16552025-9c57-4479-a23f-e9b5cfbfb5a8.png by default.

The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
